toolkit.name: Dropbox
toolkit.description: Dropbox is a cloud storage service offering file syncing, sharing, and collaboration across devices with version control and robust integrations

tools.name: Add file member
tools.description: Tool to add specified members to a Dropbox file with configurable access levels. Use when sharing a file with specific users by email or Dropbox ID. Supports custom invitation messages and notification controls. Note: This endpoint does not support apps with the app folder permission, and members will receive invitations unless quiet mode is enabled.

input.title: AddFileMemberRequest

file.title: File
file.description: File to which to add members. Use the file ID format (e.g., 'id:7bh4zBmgZoAAAAAAAAABCQ') or file path.

quiet.title: Quiet
quiet.description: Whether to suppress device notifications for added members. If false (default), members will be notified of their invitation.

items.title: MemberSelector

.tag.title: .Tag
.tag.description: Type of member selector. 'email' - Add member by email address. 'dropbox_id' - Add member by Dropbox account ID.

email.title: Email
email.description: Email address of the member to add. Required when tag is 'email'. Note: If the email is the user's main account email, they may be directly added to the membership.

dropbox_id.title: Dropbox Id
dropbox_id.description: Dropbox account, team member, or group ID. Required when tag is 'dropbox_id'.

items.description: Identifies a member to add to the file.

members.title: Members
members.description: List of members to add to the file. Each member is identified by email or Dropbox ID. Note: If an email is provided and it's the user's main account email, they may be directly added to the membership.

access_level.title: AccessLevel

.tag.title: .Tag
.tag.description: Access level for the collaborator. 'owner' - The collaborator is the owner (can view, edit, and set policies). 'editor' - The collaborator can view and edit the file. 'viewer' - The collaborator can only view the file. 'viewer_no_comment' - The collaborator can only view without commenting.

access_level.description: Defines the access level for the new member.

custom_message.title: Custom Message
examples: Sharing this file for your review
custom_message.description: Custom message to include in the invitation email sent to added members.

add_message_as_comment.title: Add Message As Comment
add_message_as_comment.description: If true and a custom_message is provided, the message will be added as a comment on the file.

input.description: Request model for adding members to a file.

tools.name: Add tag to file or folder
tools.description: Tool to add a tag to a file or folder in Dropbox. Use when you need to tag items for organization. Tags are automatically converted to lowercase.

input.title: AddFileTagsRequest

path.title: Path
path.description: Path to the file or folder to tag. Must be a valid path in the user's Dropbox.

tag_text.title: Tag Text
tag_text.description: The tag text to add. Will be automatically converted to lowercase letters by Dropbox.

Dropbox-API-Select-User.title: Dropbox Api Select User
Dropbox-API-Select-User.description: Team member ID (format: dbmid:...) required when using team tokens. Specifies which team member's account to operate on.

input.description: Request parameters for adding a tag to a file or folder.

tools.name: Add folder member
tools.description: Tool to add members to a shared folder with specified access levels. Use when an owner or editor needs to invite new members to a shared folder. Members receive invites and must be mounted via mount_folder for full access. Requires appropriate ACL permissions.

quiet.title: Quiet
quiet.description: Whether to suppress email and device notifications for the added members. If true, members are added silently without notification. Default is false

items.title: AddFolderMember

member.title: Member

.tag.title: .Tag
.tag.description: Type of member identifier: 'email' for email address, 'dropbox_id' for Dropbox account ID

email.title: Email
email.description: Email address of the member to add. Required when tag is 'email'

dropbox_id.title: Dropbox Id
dropbox_id.description: Dropbox account ID of the member to add. Required when tag is 'dropbox_id'

member.description: The member to add to the shared folder

access_level.title: Access Level

.tag.title: .Tag
.tag.description: Access level for the shared folder member: 'owner' - Full control including deletion, 'editor' - Can edit and manage content, 'viewer' - Can view and comment, 'viewer_no_comment' - Can only view without commenting

access_level.description: The access level to grant to the member

items.description: Specifies a member and their access level.

members.title: Members
members.description: List of members to add to the shared folder. Each member will receive an invitation to join the folder

custom_message.title: Custom Message
custom_message.description: Optional custom message to include in the invitation email sent to added members

shared_folder_id.title: Shared Folder Id
shared_folder_id.description: The ID of the shared folder to add members to. You can get this from list_shared_folders action

tools.name: Add members to team group
tools.description: Tool to add members to a team group with specified access levels. Use when you need to add users to an existing team group. Requires team admin credentials with group management permissions.

group.title: Group

.tag.title: .Tag
.tag.description: Type of group identifier: 'group_id' for internal Dropbox group ID, 'group_external_id' for external ID

group_id.title: Group Id
group_id.description: The internal Dropbox group ID. Required when tag is 'group_id'

group_external_id.title: Group External Id
group_external_id.description: The external ID for the group. Required when tag is 'group_external_id'

group.description: The group to add members to. Use group_id obtained from list_team_groups or create_team_group actions

items.title: GroupMemberToAdd

user.title: User

.tag.title: .Tag
.tag.description: Type of user identifier: 'team_member_id' for internal team member ID, 'external_id' for external ID, 'email' for email address

email.title: Email
email.description: The email address of the user. Required when tag is 'email'

external_id.title: External Id
external_id.description: An external ID for the user. Required when tag is 'external_id'

team_member_id.title: Team Member Id
team_member_id.description: The internal Dropbox team member ID. Required when tag is 'team_member_id'

user.description: The user to add to the group

access_type.title: Access Type

.tag.title: .Tag
.tag.description: Access level for the group member: 'member' for regular member access, 'owner' for owner privileges including ability to manage group

access_type.description: The access level to grant to the user

items.description: Specifies a user and their access level to add to the group.

members.title: Members
members.description: List of members to add to the group with their respective access levels

return_members.title: Return Members
return_members.description: Whether to return the list of members in the group after adding. Default is true

tools.name: Add team members
tools.description: Tool to add new members to a Dropbox team. Use when you need to invite users to join the team with specified roles and settings. Maximum of 20 members per request. Requires team admin credentials.

force_async.title: Force Async
force_async.description: Whether to force the operation to happen asynchronously. If true, returns an async_job_id to poll for completion. Default is false

items.title: NewMemberProfile

.tag.title: .Tag
.tag.description: Admin tier: 'team_admin' for full admin privileges, 'user_management_admin' for user management, 'support_admin' for support access, 'limited_admin' for limited privileges, 'member_only' for no admin privileges

member_email.title: Member Email
member_email.description: Email address of the new team member. Must be a valid email format

member_surname.title: Member Surname
member_surname.description: The last name of the new team member. Required for team invitation

member_given_name.title: Member Given Name
member_given_name.description: The first name of the new team member. Required for team invitation

member_external_id.title: Member External Id
member_external_id.description: External ID for the member, useful for syncing with external systems

send_welcome_email.title: Send Welcome Email
send_welcome_email.description: Whether to send a welcome email to the member. Set to false for SSO flows handling announcements themselves. Default is true

member_persistent_id.title: Member Persistent Id
member_persistent_id.description: Persistent ID for member. Only available to teams using persistent ID SAML configuration

is_directory_restricted.title: Is Directory Restricted
is_directory_restricted.description: Whether the user is directory restricted. Directory restricted users can only see members in their team directory

items.description: Profile information for a new team member to add.

new_members.title: New Members
new_members.description: List of new members to add to the team. Maximum of 20 members per request

tools.name: Copy file or folder
tools.description: Tool to copy a file or folder to a different location in Dropbox. Use when you need to duplicate content without removing the original. If the source path is a folder, all its contents will be copied.

input.title: DropboxCopyFileOrFolderRequest

to_path.title: To Path
to_path.description: Path in the user's Dropbox that is the destination. This path is case-sensitive.

from_path.title: From Path
from_path.description: Path in the user's Dropbox to be copied. This path is case-sensitive.

autorename.title: Autorename
autorename.description: If there's a conflict (e.g., a file with the same name already exists at the destination), have the Dropbox server try to auto-rename the file to avoid the conflict. The default is false.

allow_shared_folder.title: Allow Shared Folder
allow_shared_folder.description: If true, allows copying of shared folders. Note: This flag has no effect in current API version. The default is false.

dropbox_api_select_user.title: Dropbox Api Select User
dropbox_api_select_user.description: Team member ID (format: dbmid:...) required when using team tokens. Specifies which team member's account to operate on.

allow_ownership_transfer.title: Allow Ownership Transfer
allow_ownership_transfer.description: Allow moves by owner even if it would result in an ownership transfer for the content being moved. Note: This does not apply to copies. The default is false.

input.description: Request model for copying a file or folder in Dropbox.

tools.name: Create file request
tools.description: Tool to create a new file request in Dropbox. Use when you need to request files from others by generating a unique link for uploads to a specified Dropbox folder, optionally with a deadline.

input.title: CreateFileRequestRequest

open.title: Open
open.description: Whether the file request should be open by default. If true, the file request will start accepting files immediately.

title.title: Title
title.description: The title of the new file request. Must be 1 character or more.

deadline.title: FileRequestDeadlineRequest

due_date.title: Due Date
due_date.description: The deadline for the file request. Timestamps should be in UTC. Example: '2024-08-15T17:00:00Z'

allow_late_uploads.title: Allow Late Uploads
allow_late_uploads.description: Specifies the policy for uploads after the deadline. 'seven_days' or 'thirty_days' allows uploads for that period. 'always' allows indefinite late uploads. 'false' (or not set) means no late uploads.

deadline.description: Represents the deadline parameters for a file request.

destination.title: Destination
destination.description: The path in the user's Dropbox where uploaded files will be saved. Must be a path starting with '/'. Example: '/Homework/math'

input.description: Defines the parameters for creating a new file request in Dropbox.

tools.name: Create folder
tools.description: Tool to create a new folder at a specified path in Dropbox. Use when you need to organize files by creating a new directory.

path.title: Path
path.description: Path in the user's Dropbox to create the folder. Must start with a slash. May use 'id:' prefix for namespace-based paths. Must not end with '/' or whitespace. Paths are case-insensitive but must be correctly formatted to avoid validation errors.

autorename.title: Autorename
autorename.description: If there's a conflict, have the Dropbox server try to autorename the folder to avoid the conflict. Default is False. Without autorename, a conflict returns a `path_conflict` error. For idempotent folder creation, set autorename=true or treat `path_conflict` as non-fatal.

tools.name: Create paper document
tools.description: Creates a new Dropbox Paper document at the specified path using HTML or Markdown content.

path.title: Path
path.description: The fully qualified path in Dropbox where the Paper document will be created. MUST include the .paper extension at the end (e.g., '/My Documents/Notes.paper').

tools.name: Create shared link
tools.description: Tool to create a stable, long-lived shared link for a Dropbox file or folder. Use when the user needs a permanent URL suitable for embedding or long-term sharing (as opposed to temporary links that expire in hours). Supports optional settings like expiration, password protection, and visibility controls. Note: If a shared link already exists for the path, the API will return an error; in that case, use a separate list_shared_links endpoint to retrieve existing links.

input.title: CreateSharedLinkRequest

path.title: Path
path.description: The path or file identifier to be shared by the shared link. Supports Dropbox path (e.g., '/folder/file.txt'), id:..., rev:..., or ns:... notation.

settings.title: SharedLinkSettings

access.title: Access
access.description: The requested access level for the link. 'viewer' - Users can view and comment on content. 'editor' - Users can edit content.

expires.title: Expires
expires.description: The expiration date and time for the link in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2026-12-31T23:59:59Z'). If not set, the link will not expire.

audience.title: Audience
audience.description: Who can benefit from the access level of the link. 'public' - Link is accessible by anyone. 'team' - Link is accessible by team members only. 'no_one' - The link doesn't grant access.

link_password.title: Link Password
link_password.description: The password for the link if 'require_password' is true. Only applicable when password protection is enabled for the account.

allow_download.title: Allow Download
allow_download.description: Whether to allow download of the shared file or folder. If not set, defaults to true.

require_password.title: Require Password
require_password.description: Whether to require a password to access the link. If true, you must also provide 'link_password'.

requested_visibility.title: Requested Visibility
requested_visibility.description: The requested visibility for the link. 'public' - Anyone with the link can access. 'team_only' - Only team members can access. 'no_one' - Link does not grant access. Note: This field is deprecated; use 'audience' instead for newer implementations.

settings.description: Settings for the shared link configuration.

input.description: Request model for creating a shared link with settings.

tools.name: Create simple shared link (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use CreateSharedLinkV2 instead. Tool to create a basic shared link for a Dropbox file or folder. If a shared link already exists for the given path, that link is returned. Use when you need a simple shared link without advanced settings like password protection or custom expiration. For links with advanced settings, use the create_shared_link action instead.

input.title: CreateSharedLinkSimpleRequest

path.title: Path
path.description: The path to share. This can be a file or folder path in Dropbox (e.g., '/folder/file.txt'). If a shared link already exists for this path, that link will be returned instead of creating a new one.

short_url.title: Short Url
short_url.description: Whether to return a shortened URL. If true, the returned URL will be shorter and easier to share.

pending_upload.title: PendingUploadMode

.tag.title: .Tag
.tag.description: Type of pending upload. Use 'file' if the path will be a file, 'folder' if it will be a folder.

pending_upload.description: Mode for pending upload indicating file or folder type.

input.description: Request model for creating a simple shared link.

tools.name: Create team folder
tools.description: Tool to create a new, active team folder with no members in Dropbox. Use when you need to set up a new team folder for collaboration. The folder is created without any members initially.

input.title: CreateTeamFolderRequest

name.title: Name
name.description: Name for the new team folder. The name must be unique within the team.

sync_setting.title: SyncSettingEnum
sync_setting.description: Sync setting enum for the team folder.

input.description: Request model for creating a team folder.

tools.name: Create team group
tools.description: Tool to create a new, empty team group in Dropbox with a specified name. Use when you need to create a new group for organizing team members. Requires team admin credentials with team member management permissions.

group_name.title: Group Name
group_name.description: The name for the new group. Must not be empty.

group_external_id.title: Group External Id
group_external_id.description: An arbitrary external ID that the creator of the team can associate with the group for organizational purposes.

group_management_type.title: GroupManagementType
group_management_type.description: The type of group management for the team group.

tools.name: Delete file or folder
tools.description: Tool to delete a file or folder at the specified path in Dropbox. Use when you need to permanently remove a file or folder and all its contents.

path.title: Path
path.description: Path in the user's Dropbox to delete. The path must start with a slash.

parent_rev.title: Parent Rev
parent_rev.description: Perform delete if given 'rev' matches the existing file's latest 'rev'. This field does not support deleting a folder.

tools.name: Export File
tools.description: Tool to export non-downloadable Dropbox files (especially Dropbox Paper) to Markdown/HTML/plain text and return usable content. Use when you need to access content from files that cannot be downloaded directly, such as Dropbox Paper documents or Google Docs stored in Dropbox. Requires files.content.read scope.

input.title: ExportFileRequest

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: 'return_text': return exported text directly (truncated safely if very large). 'store_and_link': create a temporary Dropbox download link to the original file.

path.title: Path
path.description: The path of the file to be exported. Supports Dropbox path (e.g., '/folder/file.paper'), id:..., rev:..., or ns:... notation. Use this for non-downloadable files like Dropbox Paper documents.

export_format.title: Export Format
export_format.description: The file format to export to. Common values: 'markdown', 'html', 'plain_text'. If not specified, the default format for the file type will be used. For Dropbox Paper, default is 'markdown'.

input.description: Request parameters for exporting a Dropbox file.

tools.name: Search files and folders
tools.description: Tool to search for files and folders in Dropbox by name or content. Use when you need to find items matching a search query within a specific path or across the entire Dropbox.

input.title: DropboxFilesSearchRequest

mode.title: SearchMode
mode.description: Search mode for Dropbox files search.

path.title: Path
path.description: The path in the user's Dropbox to search. Should probably be a folder. Use empty string to search the entire Dropbox.

query.title: Query
query.description: The string to search for. The search string is split on spaces into multiple tokens. For file name searching, the last token is used for prefix matching (e.g., 'bat c' matches 'bat cave' but not 'batman car').

start.title: Start
start.description: The starting index within the search results (used for paging). Default is 0.

max_results.title: Max Results
max_results.description: The maximum number of search results to return. Default is 100, max is 1000.

input.description: Request parameters for searching files and folders in Dropbox.

tools.name: Get account
tools.description: Tool to get information about a user's Dropbox account using their account ID. Use when you need to retrieve account details for a specific user.

account_id.title: Account Id
account_id.description: A user's account identifier. Can be obtained from get_current_account endpoint.

tools.name: Get file or folder metadata
tools.description: Tool to fetch metadata for a file or folder by path. Use when you need to verify existence, get canonical identifiers (id, path_display), determine type (.tag), or retrieve detailed attributes without enumerating folder contents.

input.title: GetMetadataRequest

path.title: Path
path.description: The path of a file or folder on Dropbox (e.g., "/Documents/report.pdf"). Note: The root folder ("" or "/") is not supported by this endpoint.

include_deleted.title: Include Deleted
include_deleted.description: If true, DeletedMetadata will be returned for deleted files or folders. Otherwise, deleted items will return an error.

include_media_info.title: Include Media Info
include_media_info.description: If true, FileMetadata.media_info is set for photo and video files, providing additional metadata like dimensions and location.

include_has_explicit_shared_members.title: Include Has Explicit Shared Members
include_has_explicit_shared_members.description: If true, the result will include a flag indicating whether the file has any explicit shared members.

input.description: Request parameters for fetching metadata.

tools.name: Get shared folder metadata
tools.description: Tool to retrieve metadata for a specific shared folder by its ID. Use when you need detailed information about a shared folder including access level, policies, owner, paths, and permissions.

.tag.title: .Tag
.tag.description: Folder action type (e.g., 'change_options', 'edit_contents', 'invite_editor', 'invite_viewer', 'leave_a_copy', 'share_link', 'create_link', 'unshare')

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: A list of FolderActions corresponding to FolderPermissions that should appear in the response's permissions field describing the actions the authenticated user can perform on the folder

shared_folder_id.title: Shared Folder Id
shared_folder_id.description: The ID for the shared folder

tools.name: Get space usage
tools.description: Tool to get space usage information for the current user's Dropbox account. Use when you need to check storage usage, available space, or quota information.

input.title: GetSpaceUsageRequest
input.description: Request model for getting space usage. This endpoint requires no parameters.

tools.name: Get team info
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about a Dropbox team. Use when you need to get team details such as team name, ID, licensed user counts, or team policies.

input.title: GetTeamInfoRequest
input.description: Request model for getting team information. This endpoint requires no parameters.

tools.name: Get team audit log events
tools.description: Tool to retrieve team audit log events from Dropbox. Use when you need to access team activity logs, audit trails, or monitor team events. Supports filtering by time range and event category, with pagination for large result sets.

input.title: GetTeamLogEventsRequest

end_time.title: End Time
end_time.description: Ending time for the range filter (ISO 8601 format, e.g., '2023-12-31T23:59:59Z').

start_time.title: Start Time
start_time.description: Starting time for the range filter (ISO 8601 format, e.g., '2023-01-01T00:00:00Z').

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of events to return per request. Default is 1000, maximum is 1000.

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.description: Cursor for pagination, obtained from a previous response. Use this to retrieve the next page of results.

category.title: Category
category.description: Event category filter to limit results (e.g., 'apps', 'devices', 'domains', 'file_operations', 'file_requests', 'groups', 'logins', 'members', 'paper', 'passwords', 'sharing', 'team_folders', 'team_policies').

input.description: Request parameters for fetching team audit log events.

tools.name: List file requests
tools.description: Tool to list all file requests owned by the current user. Use when you need to see existing file requests, their status, and details.

input.title: ListFileRequestsRequest

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of file requests to return. Default: 1000.

input.description: Request model for listing file requests.

tools.name: List file revisions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the revision history for a file. Use when you need to see past versions of a file, restore a previous version, or track changes over time.

input.title: ListFileRevisionsRequest

.tag.title: .Tag
.tag.description: Determines the behavior of the API in listing revisions. 'path' returns revisions with the same file path as identified by the latest file entry at the given file path or id. 'id' returns revisions with the same file id as identified by the latest file entry at the given file path or id.

path.title: Path
path.description: The path to the file you want to see the revisions of (e.g., "/Documents/report.pdf"). Must be a valid file path in Dropbox.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: The maximum number of revision entries returned. Default is 10, minimum is 1, maximum is 100.

input.description: Request parameters for listing file revisions.

tools.name: List files in folder
tools.description: Tool to list files and folders in a specified Dropbox directory. Use when you need to see the contents of a folder, including subfolders if recursive is true. When the response contains `has_more=true`, continue fetching with the returned cursor until `has_more=false` — stopping early misses entries in large folders. Response entries include both files and folders; use the `.tag` field on each entry to distinguish item types.

path.title: Path
path.description: The folder path (e.g., "/europe/invoices") or folder ID (e.g., "id:aBcDeFgH123") to list contents from. Use "" (empty string) for the root folder. No trailing slashes or whitespace allowed — malformed paths can silently produce empty results. Prefer paths from `path_display` or `path_lower` fields in prior API responses over manually constructed paths.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: The maximum number of results to return per request. Default is 2000. Max is 2000.

recursive.title: Recursive
recursive.description: If true, recursively lists contents of nested subfolders; otherwise, lists only immediate contents. Large or broad folder trees with recursive=true can produce very large responses and high latency; use only when full hierarchy is explicitly needed.

include_deleted.title: Include Deleted
include_deleted.description: If true, includes deleted (but potentially recoverable) files and folders in the listing.

include_media_info.title: Include Media Info
include_media_info.description: If true, includes media metadata (e.g., dimensions, location) for photo and video files.

include_non_downloadable_files.title: Include Non Downloadable Files
include_non_downloadable_files.description: If true, includes non-downloadable files (e.g., Google Docs, Dropbox Paper) in the listing.

tools.name: List folder continue
tools.description: Tool to continue paginating through folder contents using a cursor from list_folder. Use when has_more is true to retrieve remaining entries.

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.description: The cursor returned by your last call to list_folder or list_folder/continue. Use this to paginate through all files and retrieve updates to the folder.

tools.name: List Paper docs
tools.description: Tool to return the list of all Paper docs according to filter and sort specifications. Use when you need to retrieve Paper document IDs for further operations. To iterate through full pagination, pass the cursor to docs/list/continue.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Size limit per batch. The maximum number of docs that can be retrieved per batch is 1000. Higher value results in invalid arguments error.

sort_by.title: Sort By
sort_by.description: Allows user to specify how the Paper docs should be sorted. 'accessed' sorts by last accessed time, 'modified' sorts by last modified time, 'created' sorts by creation time.

filter_by.title: Filter By
filter_by.description: Allows user to specify how the Paper docs should be filtered. 'docs_accessed' fetches all Paper doc IDs that the user has ever accessed. 'docs_created' fetches only the Paper doc IDs that the user has created.

sort_order.title: Sort Order
sort_order.description: Allows user to specify the sort order of the result. 'ascending' sorts in ascending order, 'descending' sorts in descending order.

tools.name: List received files
tools.description: Tool to list all files shared with the current user. Returns files directly shared with the user but does not include files received via shared folders or unclaimed invitations. Use when discovering files that have been shared with the authenticated user.

input.title: ListReceivedFilesRequest

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Number of files to return max per query. Defaults to 100 if no limit is specified. Must be between 1 and 300.

items.title: FileAction

.tag.title: .Tag
.tag.description: The file action type. Possible values: 'disable_viewer_info', 'edit_contents', 'enable_viewer_info', 'invite_viewer', 'invite_viewer_no_comment', 'unshare', 'relinquish_membership', 'share_link', 'create_link', 'other'

items.description: Actions that may be taken on files.

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: A list of FileActions corresponding to FilePermissions that should appear in the response's SharedFileMetadata.permissions field describing the actions the authenticated user can perform on the file.

input.description: Request model for listing received files.

tools.name: List shared folders
tools.description: Tool to list all shared folders the authenticated user has access to. Use when discovering shared or team-mounted folders that may not appear in a standard path listing. Returns metadata including folder name, ID, access level, and paths (if mounted).

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of shared folders to return per request

tools.name: List shared links
tools.description: Tool to list existing shared links for the current user, optionally filtered by path. Use when you need to discover or reuse existing shared links to avoid creating duplicates or to check what links already exist for a file or folder. Supports pagination via cursor for large result sets.

input.title: ListSharedLinksRequest

path.title: Path
path.description: The path to the file or folder to list shared links for. If omitted, returns all shared links for the current user. If provided, returns links that grant access to the specified path (including parent folder links unless direct_only is true). Supports Dropbox path notation (e.g., '/folder/file.txt').

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.description: The cursor returned by a previous call to this endpoint. Use this to retrieve additional results when 'has_more' is true. The API returns a maximum of ~200 links per call.

direct_only.title: Direct Only
direct_only.description: If true, only return direct links to the specified path. If false or omitted, also include links to parent folders. Only relevant when 'path' is specified.

input.description: Request model for listing shared links.

tools.name: List team folders
tools.description: Tool to list all team folders for a Dropbox Business team. Use when you need to discover team-wide folders or manage team folder access.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of team folders to return per request

tools.name: List team members

Supports changing audience (public/team/private), access level (viewer/editor), expiration dates, and password protection.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL of the shared link to modify. This must be a valid Dropbox shared link URL.

settings.title: Settings

access.title: Access
access.description: The requested access level for the link. 'viewer' - Users can view and comment on content. 'editor' - Users can edit content.

expires.title: Expires
expires.description: The expiration date and time for the link in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2026-12-31T23:59:59Z'). If not set, the link will not expire.

audience.title: Audience
audience.description: Who can benefit from the access level of the link. 'public' - Link is accessible by anyone. 'team' - Link is accessible by team members only. 'no_one' - The link doesn't grant access.

link_password.title: Link Password
link_password.description: The password for the link if 'require_password' is true. Only applicable when password protection is enabled for the account.

allow_download.title: Allow Download
allow_download.description: Whether to allow download of the shared file or folder. If not set, defaults to true.

require_password.title: Require Password
require_password.description: Whether to require a password to access the link. If true, you must also provide 'link_password'.

requested_visibility.title: Requested Visibility
requested_visibility.description: The requested visibility for the link. 'public' - Anyone with the link can access. 'team_only' - Only team members can access. 'no_one' - Link does not grant access. Note: This field is deprecated; use 'audience' instead for newer implementations.

settings.description: The new settings to apply to the shared link. Only the specified fields will be updated; unspecified fields remain unchanged.

remove_expiration.title: Remove Expiration
remove_expiration.description: If set to true, removes the expiration date from the shared link. This overrides any 'expires' value in settings.

to_path.description: Path in the user's Dropbox that is the destination. This path is case-sensitive.

autorename.title: Autorename
autorename.description: If there's a conflict (e.g., a file with the same name already exists at the destination), have the Dropbox server try to auto-rename the file to avoid the conflict. The default is false. Leaving this false will cause the call to fail outright when a name conflict exists at the destination.

allow_shared_folder.title: Allow Shared Folder
allow_shared_folder.description: If true, allows moving shared folders. The default is false.

allow_ownership_transfer.title: Allow Ownership Transfer
allow_ownership_transfer.description: Allow moves by owner even if it would result in an ownership transfer for the content being moved. This does not apply to copies. The default is false.

input.description: Request model for moving a file or folder in Dropbox.

tools.name: Read a file
tools.description: Downloads a file from the specified Dropbox path, requiring `files.content.read` scope. Response field `file_content_bytes` is base64-encoded binary; decode before saving or passing to libraries. Bursty reads may trigger HTTP 429; honor the `Retry-After` header.

path.title: Path
path.description: The path to search in Must be a canonical Dropbox path from `path_display` or `path_lower` in API results — hand-typed paths frequently cause not-found or 409 errors. Paths in shared/team folders may become invalid if items are moved or access is revoked.

tools.name: Continue Dropbox Search
tools.description: Tool to fetch the next page of search results from a previous Dropbox search. Use when you have a cursor from a search operation and need to retrieve additional results. Note: search along with search_continue can only retrieve a maximum of 10,000 matches total.

input.title: SearchContinueRequest

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.description: The cursor returned by your last call to search or search_continue. Used to fetch the next page of results.

input.description: Request model for continuing a Dropbox search.

tools.name: Search File or Folder
tools.description: Tool to search for files and folders in Dropbox by name or content, optionally scoped to a path, with pagination support. Results paginate via cursor (up to 100 per page); check `has_more` in the response and re-fetch with the cursor until `has_more` is false. Newly indexed items may have a brief delay before appearing. Verify `path_display` and `.tag` (file vs folder) on each result before acting, as multiple similar-named items may match. Results are limited to items visible to the authenticated user.

query.title: Query
query.description: The search string. Must be 1 or more non-whitespace characters. Queries are case-insensitive. Required unless cursor is provided.

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.description: Cursor from a previous search response for fetching the next page of results. When provided, all other parameters are ignored and the continue endpoint is called.

options.title: SearchOptions

path.title: Path
path.description: Scopes the search to the given path and its subfolders. Provide an empty string to search the root. Non-root paths must start with '/' (e.g., '/my-folder'). If the leading slash is missing, it will be automatically prepended. If None, searches the entire Dropbox.

order_by.title: SearchOrderBy
order_by.description: Order by options for search results.

file_status.title: File Status
file_status.description: Restricts search to files with the given status. Can be 'active' (default) or 'deleted'. To search both, omit this parameter or make separate requests.

max_results.title: Max Results
max_results.description: The maximum number of search results to return per request. Default is 100, min 1, max 1000.

filename_only.title: Filename Only
filename_only.description: Restricts search to only match on filenames.

file_categories.title: File Categories
file_categories.description: Restricts search to only match files in the given categories.

file_extensions.title: File Extensions
file_extensions.description: Restricts search to only match files with the given extensions (e.g., ['jpg', 'png']). This is case-insensitive.

options.description: Additional options for the search. If not provided, default search options will be used. Key sub-fields: `path` (must start with '/' or use 'id:...' format; omit to search entire account, narrow to reduce noise); `file_categories` and `file_extensions` to filter by type; no native date-range filter — apply date logic client-side using `server_modified` (UTC). Prefer reusing `path_display` values from prior results rather than manually composing paths.

match_field_options.title: MatchFieldOptions

include_highlights.title: Include Highlights
include_highlights.description: If true, highlight information for the matches will be returned.

match_field_options.description: Options for match field highlighting. If not provided, default options will be used.

Dropbox-API-Select-User.title: Dropbox Api Select User
Dropbox-API-Select-User.description: Team member ID (format: dbmid:...) required when using team tokens. Specifies which team member's account to operate on.

tools.name: Search File Properties

items.title: PropertiesSearchQuery

.tag.title: .Tag

field_name.title: Field Name
field_name.description: The name of the property field to search within.

mode.description: The mode with which to perform the search, specifying which field to search within.

query.title: Query

logical_operator.title: LogicalOperator

.tag.title: .Tag
.tag.description: The logical operator to join search queries. Currently only 'or_operator' is supported.

logical_operator.description: The logical operator with which to append the query.

items.description: A single search query for property field values.

queries.title: Queries
queries.description: List of queries to search. Required unless cursor is provided. Each query specifies a property field value to search for and the field name to search within.

template_filter.title: TemplateFilter

.tag.description: The type of filter. Use 'filter_some' to filter by specific template IDs, or 'filter_none' to return all templates.

filter_some.title: Filter Some
filter_some.description: List of template IDs to filter by. Only required when tag is 'filter_some'.

template_filter.description: Filter results to contain only properties associated with specific template IDs.

input.description: Request to search across property templates for particular property field values.

member_policy.description: Policy governing who can be a member of a shared folder.

.tag.description: Who can add, remove, or change the privileges of members. 'owner' - Only the owner can update the ACL. 'editors' - Any editor can update the ACL. 'other' - Other.
